system.description: A Focus for a resilient mineral-bodied character who channels stone, endurance, and crushing force.

abilities.name: Intimidating Presence
abilities.description: Your formidable mineral appearance supports intimidation attempts.

abilities.name: Stone Body
abilities.description: Your mineral form improves resilience and unarmed force, while making evasive movement harder.

abilities.name: Stoneknowing
abilities.description: Study touched stone or crystal to learn useful structural facts.

abilities.name: Stone Bash
abilities.description: A carefully timed unarmed strike hits harder.

abilities.name: Golem Grip
abilities.description: Seize and restrain a foe with powerful stone hands.

abilities.name: Field of Stones
abilities.description: Blend into natural terrain as a rock formation.

abilities.name: Improved Stone Body
abilities.description: Your mineral body withstands an additional moderate wound.

abilities.name: Golem Stomp
abilities.description: Create a close shock wave that harms and displaces several foes.

abilities.name: Heavy Hands
abilities.description: Your unarmed attacks gain additional force.

abilities.name: Deep Reserves
abilities.description: Redistribute a limited amount between your Pools during a demanding recovery cycle.

abilities.name: Rolling Stone
abilities.description: Curl into a charging boulder to strike several foes across a long movement.

abilities.name: Still As a Statue
abilities.description: Enter an inert stone state that trades awareness and movement for exceptional recovery and protection.

abilities.name: Structural Brace
abilities.description: Become a living support capable of holding a threatened structure or immense weight.

abilities.name: Mineralization
abilities.description: Your mineral nature lets you withstand an additional major wound.

abilities.name: Earthshake
abilities.description: Trigger a violent earth movement that damages terrain and endangers creatures in an area.
